title: Open Air Chicago hourly aggregations (catalog.data.gov link, not reached)
summary: Human-supplied link to a data.gov catalog record titled "Open Air Chicago hour aggregations", described as hourly air-quality sensor data from a US city. The link could not be inspected because its host, catalog.data.gov, is not on the allowlist, so no metadata, licence, schema, files or coverage dates were read. The candidate is outside the use case geography (IT) and its coverage against the 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 prototype window is unknown.

quality_notes: Source unreachable: inspect_dataset_link returned DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWLISTED for host catalog.data.gov. No metadata, licence or sample was obtained.

Geographic mismatch: the candidate is described as a US city dataset; the use case primary geography is IT (Valdena, northern Italy). Even if accessible, it would not cover the client's stations or clinics.
Relevance is limited to N1 (hourly pollutant concentrations) at most; it does not address N2 (traffic), N4-N5 (clinic data) or the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
The candidate's suspected_issues list is empty and the why_relevant text was supplied by a human; neither was verified.
